fullProfile.headline: CMO at i-SmokeStack | Chief Marketing & Operations Advisor (Celestial AI, AYU Inc USA) | Fractional CMO (Datt Mediproducts, AYU Lifescience) | VP Product Marketing (Lasersec) | Founder, Sonia Specialist
about: I notice what others don't. The gaps, the confusion, the unspoken story, and I help make sense of it.
I've always been the kind of person who likes to understand things deeply and fix them from the root—that's how I approach brand, demand, communication, and team leadership.
I focus on simplicity: knowing what the business truly needs, how people think, and what steps will genuinely move things forward.
My strength isn't just one skill—it lies in seeing the whole picture: how brand affects revenue, how messaging affects conversion, how operations affect execution, and how people affect everything.
I work with a steady mind, bring structure without chaos, and help teams feel confident and connected in what they're building.

frame.title: Seeing the Whole Picture
frame.intro: Sonia doesn't believe in complicating marketing to sound clever. Her edge is connecting what isolated specialists miss.

cards.story: Positioning isn't decoration—clarity in what a company stands for directly accelerates demand and closes pipeline.

knowledgeBase.response: My school years at Ryan International (1999–2000) and Vidya Mandir (2001–2002) shaped my instincts long before business school. Between debates, dance, studying Non-Medical subjects and French, and competing in National Volleyball, I learned how to stay steady under pressure and read the whole court.

From 2002 to 2006, I completed my B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication at Maharshi Dayanand University. Alongside engineering, I conducted the Monthly Newspaper, participated actively in PDP classes, and helped organize college fests—where my love for both structured systems and clear storytelling first came together.

While starting my career, I pursued two management programs simultaneously: an Executive MBA in Marketing at IIM Bangalore (2007–2008), where I worked on a Strategy Project with Carnegie Mellon University, and a PGDBM in Marketing and Sales at Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies (2007–2009).

My corporate journey began at Bosch in 2006 as a Marketing Management Trainee in Bengaluru and then Marketing Specialist across India and Hong Kong until 2008. I handled full product launches, ran Google AdWords PPC and Eloqua campaigns, and collaborated with Carnegie Mellon University on Competitive SWOT positioning.

From 2008 to 2013, I scaled B2B marketing first at FARO Technologies across India and Asia—building their Sales Toolkit, white papers, case studies, and knowledge base—and then as Head of Marketing and Sales at Creaform Inc. in the US, leading SEO, paid keywords, and drip nurturing.

At ShowMeLeads Inc in the San Francisco Bay Area (2013–2014), we built Marketo and Salesforce CRM lead-scoring and nurturing funnels that achieved an 80% email delivery rate and drove 1,200 new opportunities and 100 closed deals in 2014.

At Appirio, I was promoted from Senior Demand Generation Manager to Director of Demand Gen, Marketing and Sales Operations in just 6 months. I built the entire 15-member Jaipur Marketing Center from hiring to training, and played a key role in growing company value from X to 5X million in 18 months.

Before and alongside my corporate leadership, I served as Founder & CEO in 2013–2014 and later on the Advisory Board of Brand Tadkaa in San Diego from 2014 to 2019, helping them build pipeline and revenue as a market influencer.

At Lasersec Technologies, I led a global team of over 20 marketing professionals across digital, demand ops, web, and sales development—and today serve as VP Product Marketing. We spearheaded the #FightFakes security hologram campaign protecting manufacturers from counterfeit auto spare parts.

From 2018 to 2020 at RoundGlass in Gurgaon and remotely for the US, I served as Leader and then Digital Marketing Director—aligning campaigns and brand communications directly with long-term measurable business outcomes.

Since March 2020, I have served as Chief Marketing Officer at i-SmokeStack. My focus there is turning fragmented early-stage startup teams into aligned, confident growth engines—cutting bottlenecks and turning complex challenges into simple, high-impact marketing.

Currently alongside i-SmokeStack, I serve as Chief Marketing & Operations Advisor for Celestial AI and AYU Inc USA (Boston), and Fractional Marketing Lead / CMO for AYU Lifescience in Dubai and Datt Mediproducts in New Delhi—building human-first marketing systems and TGA-aligned buyer experiences.

Sonia Specialist in Gurugram is my 13-year commitment to helping startups and small businesses become Modern Marketers through free consultancy and practical research—including curating free social media management tools for entrepreneurs.

My core strength isn't a single skill—it's seeing the whole picture: how brand drives revenue, how messaging drives conversion, and how operations empower people. I notice the gaps and unspoken confusion others miss, and bring calm structure without chaos.

I'm always open to connecting with people who are building, learning, or growing and want marketing that feels clear and human. You can reach me on LinkedIn at SoniaSpecialist, or drop your note right here using the Leave Note button below.

On the execution side, I've worked hands-on across Marketo and Salesforce CRM—achieving an 80% email delivery rate at ShowMeLeads—alongside Eloqua, Google Analytics, Google AdWords PPC, SEO, drip nurturing, and CRM tracking for medical and SaaS buyers.

I love distilling real team lessons into practical writing—like my pieces on how to build a successful digital marketing team, comparing Specialists versus Generalists, and researching free social media management tools for startups, alongside creative roadmaps like Lasersec's Past, Present, Future.

A few milestones I'm proud of: helping grow Appirio's value from X to 5X million in 18 months while building a 15-member Jaipur Marketing Center, driving 1,200 opportunities and 100 closed deals at ShowMeLeads, and leading 20+ global marketers at Lasersec.

My work has spanned continents—from Bengaluru, Jaipur, Gurugram, Noida, and New Delhi in India, to Hong Kong and Asia-wide launches at Bosch and FARO, Dubai for AYU Lifescience, and Boston, San Francisco, and San Diego in the US.

Beyond marketing frameworks, my personality was forged on debate stages, dance floors, and National Volleyball courts—and later conducting my college Monthly Newspaper and organizing fests at MDU. I enjoy bringing that same energy, curiosity, and steady teamwork into every room.
